history.description: dotfiles history: what is never captured, reload commands, and the setup repository (https://mise.jdx.dev/history.html)

encryption.description: encryption for dotfiles tracked with encrypt = true

recipients.description: shared age, SSH, or age-plugin public recipients for all encrypted dotfiles

exclude.description: globs never captured by dotfiles history; a `!glob` entry re-includes a path an earlier glob excluded

git_email.description: email used for history commit authors and committers; {hostname} expands to this machine's hostname

machine.description: this machine's name in per-machine streams (variants = [{ machine = true }]) instead of the name generated with the history store

reload.description: commands run once after a rollback, undo, pull, or dotfiles apply writes a path matching the glob (trusted global or system config only)

additionalProperties.description: command to run once when a rollback, undo, pull, or dotfiles apply writes a path matching this glob

origin.description: the setup repository this machine publishes to and fetches from; machine-local, written by `mise bootstrap dotfiles origin set`

task_config.description: configuration for task execution and management

tool_config.description: policy for tools declared by this config root

task_templates.description: task templates that can be extended by tasks via extends

additionalProperties.description: a version of the tool, or a table with its version and options

hooks.description: hooks to run on events like cd, enter, leave

vars.description: variables to set for use in config templates

watch_files.description: files to watch for changes and run scripts when modified

_.description: free-form data for your own use; mise never reads it

daemons.description: Experimental project daemons: custom pitchfork commands or managed presets.

additionalProperties.description: A daemon: a version request for the preset of the same name, or a table describing a custom command, task, preset, another project's daemon, or a shared provider.

oneOf.description: Version request for a preset matching the daemon name.

run.description: Shell command for the daemon's long-running process.

mise.description: false runs the process and its setup without the project's tool environment.

oneOf.description: Pitchfork's structured port configuration, forwarded verbatim.

task.description: mise task run as this daemon's long-running process

args.description: arguments passed to the task after `--`

data_dir.description: Persistent preset data directory, relative to the declaring project root or absolute. Defaults to mise state storage.

preset.description: Service preset that supplies the daemon's command, port and data directory.

version.description: Version request for the preset's tool.

ports.description: Overrides for the preset's additional named ports.

additionalProperties.description: Port for this named port of the preset.

run.description: Shell command that replaces the preset's command.

oneOf.description: Daemon declared by another project, run under that project's namespace and root.

project.description: Directory of a project whose mise configuration declares the daemon. A relative path resolves against this project root.

name.description: Daemon name inside the referenced project, when it differs from this key.

provider.description: Name of a globally defined shared server provider.

resource.description: Database or NATS account shared by consumers choosing this name. Omit for a checkout-specific resource.

daemon_providers.description: Experimental shared servers owned by the user. Only allowed in global configuration.

additionalProperties.description: A PostgreSQL, CockroachDB or NATS server that every checkout shares, with a separate database or NATS account for each.

preset.description: Service preset that runs the server.

version.description: Version request for the preset's tool.

ports.description: Overrides for the preset's additional named ports.

additionalProperties.description: Port for this named port of the preset.

data_dir.description: Persistent server data directory; a relative path resolves inside the provider's state directory. Defaults to $MISE_STATE_DIR/daemon-providers/<name>/data.

tool.description: Tool to install the server from, in place of the preset's default.

namespace.description: Fixed pitchfork namespace for this project, replacing the hashed default so other projects can refer to its daemons by qualified ID.

namespace_per_worktree.description: Append a worktree-specific suffix to an explicit namespace when the project root is a linked git worktree.

daemon_groups.description: Experimental named groups of project daemons. Members are daemon names or other group names declared in the same project.

oneOf.description: Daemon or group names in this project.

daemons.description: Daemon or group names in this project.
